smart_box.name: SBBox-Narration
smart_box.description: Smart Box responsible for resolving and controlling narration associated with educational book pages.

narration_id.description: Stable identifier of the narration resource.

narration.description: Resolved narration resource associated with the stable narration identifier.

narration_state.description: Current logical state of the narration.

rules: Narration is identified by a stable narration identifier.
The narration identifier is independent of the narration provider.
SBBox-Narration does not expose provider-specific implementation details.
SBBox-Narration does not depend on a specific technology or provider.
Only SBBox-Narration controls narration playback state.
Narration resources are resolved through an adapter.
SBBox-Narration does not control page navigation.
SBBox-Narration exposes WHAT narration operation is requested, not HOW playback is implemented.
